Text: What... where am I?
A graveyard? Why am I here? Why does everything feel so... strange?
Wait... this tombstone... Let me read it closer.

Speaker: Akila
Text: There is a worn stone around the gate. I should go look at it to help me open this.
This stone besides the gate is worn smooth by time.
Three faint markings are carved into its surface.
Someone scratched a message below them:
“Three memories linger in this graveyard. Return what was lost… and the path will open.”

Speaker: Akila
Text: Looks like I should talk to these three memories before leaving this graveyard.

Speaker: Akila
Text: The carving is still visible.

Speaker: Akila
Text: “Three memories… Return what was lost, and the path will open.”
Akila... that's... that's my name. But why is it on a—

Speaker: Akila
Text: No. No, no, no. This can't be right.

Speaker: Akila
Text: I'm... I'm dead? How? When? I don't remember anything...

Speaker: Akila
Text: My hands... I can see through them. I really am... a ghost.

Speaker: Akila
Text: What happened to me? How did I die?

Speaker: Akila
Text: There's something... unfinished. I can feel it. Something keeping me here.

Speaker: Akila
Text: I need to find out more. I need to leave this graveyard.

Speaker: Akila
Text: Akila... that's my name. I need to get out of this graveyard.

Speaker: Gentle Ghost
Text: ...You can see me?

Speaker: Gentle Ghost
Text: It has been so long since anyone stopped here.

Speaker: Gentle Ghost
Text: Every year... when the weather grew warm... I used to bring something here.

Speaker: Gentle Ghost
Text: It was soft… delicate… and carried a floral scent.

Speaker: Gentle Ghost
Text: If you happen to find something like that nearby… could you bring it to me?

Speaker: Gentle Ghost
Text: Did you find what once carried that floral scent?

Speaker: Gentle Ghost
Text: The rose is beautiful.

Speaker: Gentle Ghost
Text: I have nothing more to give you.

Speaker: Gentle Ghost
Text: But do not forget, the circle comes first.

Speaker: Gentle Ghost
Text: ...A rose. Thank you! Its scent is just as I remember.

Speaker: Gentle Ghost
Text: It helped me remember the living world and I suppose it could help you as well.

Speaker: Gentle Ghost
Text: Beyond this graveyard stands a gate sealed by old symbols.

Speaker: Gentle Ghost
Text: I remember the first mark clearly.

Speaker: Gentle Ghost
Text: The circle always comes first, remember that.

Speaker: Gentle Ghost
Text: ...No… that is not it.

Speaker: Gentle Ghost
Text: What I remember was fragile… and alive with color.

Speaker: Gentle Ghost
Text: It carried the scent of spring.

Speaker: Wandering Ghost
Text: ...You can hear me too?

Speaker: Wandering Ghost
Text: I remember holding something tightly in my hands.

Speaker: Wandering Ghost
Text: It was fragile… thin… and covered in words.

Speaker: Wandering Ghost
Text: The wind kept trying to steal it from me so I had to crush it in my fist.

Speaker: Wandering Ghost
Text: If you happen to find something like that nearby… would you bring it here?

Speaker: Wandering Ghost
Text: Did you find the words I never finished?

Speaker: Wandering Ghost
Text: ...Thank you again for returning my words.

Speaker: Wandering Ghost
Text: I feel lighter now.

Speaker: Wandering Ghost
Text: Do not forget, the triangle is in between the symbols.

Speaker: Wandering Ghost
Text: ...So it really was still here.

Speaker: Wandering Ghost
Text: The words are faded now… but I can still see part of it.

Speaker: Wandering Ghost
Text: There a triangle… in between the symbols.

Speaker: Wandering Ghost
Text: Perhaps this is what you are searching for.

Speaker: Wandering Ghost
Text: ...No… that isn't it.

Speaker: Wandering Ghost
Text: What I lost was lighter than stone… and softer than metal.

Speaker: Wandering Ghost
Text: It carried words that were never meant to be forgotten.

Speaker: Restless Ghost
Text: ...This place used to hold something important.

Speaker: Restless Ghost
Text: I remember trying to leave… but something was locked.

Speaker: Restless Ghost
Text: There was a small piece of cold metal in my hand.

Speaker: Restless Ghost
Text: It fit perfectly into something… but I cannot remember what.

Speaker: Restless Ghost
Text: If you find something like that… would you bring it to me?

Speaker: Restless Ghost
Text: Did you find what once carried that sweet scent?

Speaker: Restless Ghost
Text: The memory has settled now.

Speaker: Restless Ghost
Text: I remember a square lies in the sequence but it was not the first nor second.

Speaker: Restless Ghost
Text: ...Yes. This is the one.

Speaker: Restless Ghost
Text: The sound it made when it turned… I remember now.

Speaker: Restless Ghost
Text: The symbol I saw that night. It was not the first or the second.

Speaker: Restless Ghost
Text: That symbol was a square.

Speaker: Restless Ghost
Text: No… that is not what I lost.

Speaker: Restless Ghost
Text: What I remember was small… heavy… and cold.

Speaker: Akila
Text: This door... I think it is calling for me. Is this where I should go?

Speaker: Akila
Text: But I can't get through. There's something stopping me.

Speaker: Akila
Text: I'm missing something.

Speaker: Akila
Text: It's still not allowing me to pass.

Speaker: Akila
Text: The gate unlocked!

Speaker: Akila
Text: Now that I have helped the three spirits, I should know how to solve this.
Leaving already? I don't even remember who I am…

Speaker: Akila
Text: The gate is still shut… maybe the order is wrong.

Speaker: Akila
Text: MOM??? MOM!

Speaker: Mom
Text: *Brrr* Oh dear it sure is cold all of a sudden...

Speaker: Mom
Text: I keep telling Bill to keep the windows closed! *tsk tsk*

Speaker: Akila
Text: Mom... why can't you see me.
